label: Ubiquiti UniFi AP (first-generation UAP)
description: Ubiquiti UniFi AP, first generation - one 10/100 Ethernet port with passive PoE 12-24 V in (4 W maximum draw) and a single 802.11n 2x2 radio on 2.4 GHz (300 Mbps). Ceiling/wall mount, managed by the UniFi Controller; no 5 GHz radio and no gigabit copper.
notes: The first-generation UAP, not the UAP-AC series: 2.4 GHz only, 802.11n 2x2, and **10/100** copper with passive 12-24 V PoE. A lab that models this as a dual-band gigabit AP is describing a different product, which is exactly the confusion that makes a rebuilt topology subtly wrong about the hardware on the wall. It has no console - management is the UniFi Controller - so no `cli` capability is declared.
